sentences.text: On 1.27, when scaling down a ReplicaSet, if the `controller.kubernetes.io/pod-deletion-cost` annotation is set, the pod with the lower value is chosen first for deletion.

citations.quote: If `controller.kubernetes.io/pod-deletion-cost` annotation is set, then the pod with the lower value will come first.
